stops.name: Weser river valley
stops.quote: As part of the Weser Uplands, this walking region offers the best of both worlds: bordered by the romantic Weser river valley and dotted with picturesque towns and villages, it rises into a dramatic low mountain landscape with rugged cliffs and sweeping views.
stops.english: As part of the Weser Uplands, this walking region offers the best of both worlds: bordered by the romantic Weser river valley and dotted with picturesque towns and villages, it rises into a dramatic low mountain landscape with rugged cliffs and sweeping views.

stops.name: Weser Uplands Route (Weserbergland-Weg)
stops.quote: Two long-distance routes, the Weser Uplands Route (Weserbergland-Weg) and the Ith-Hils-Weg , complete the walking experience, ensuring there’s something for everyone.
stops.english: Two long-distance routes, the Weser Uplands Route (Weserbergland-Weg) and the Ith-Hils-Weg , complete the walking experience, ensuring there’s something for everyone.

stops.name: Solling-Vogler Nature Park
stops.quote: Narrow ridges, steep slopes and deeply carved valleys, interspersed with traditional orchards and dry grasslands lined with hedgerows: the Solling-Vogler Nature Park , at the heart of the Weser Uplands, offers a rich and varied landscape full of discovery.

stops.name: Wildpark-Haus
stops.quote: At the Wildpark-Haus , you can explore a range of fascinating topics in an interactive exhibition, including the diverse habitats found in the Solling.

stops.name: Neuhaus Wildlife Park
stops.quote: Our tip: Visit the Neuhaus Wildlife Park next door, where native wildlife can be observed in naturalistic enclosures.
